notes: Self-contained harness demo. Runs fully offline with examples/demo-skill/stub_runner.py as the 'model'. The two ablations each remove one load-bearing piece of the skill and confirm a regression on a distinct assertion.

cases.prompt: Review this change: it adds a new HTTP endpoint with no test. Give me your review.
expected_behavior: Label the finding's severity (Blocking / Minor / Clean).
Follow the review checklist and cite the file and line.

expected_regressions.summary: without the severity rule the reviewer stops labeling findings
with the checklist content gone the reviewer stops citing file/line
